POS Launch
New Product · June 2026
The complete store,
on one screen.
AgroStar POS is built from the ground up to run our Company Owned stores — connecting orders, inventory, and finance into a single mobile-first experience.
Aim
Give every store manager one screen to run their entire store — stock, sales, payments, and reconciliation — without touching any other system.
TL;DR — 30 seconds
→  We built AgroStar POS — purpose-built for our 7 Company Owned stores, end-to-end.
→  One screen replaces CRM + WMS + NAV — all talking to each other in real time.
→  Live since May 15 · 65 orders · 57 farmers served · ₹73,824 GMV · growing every week.

Magic Moment 01
The stock arrives.
The store is ready
in minutes.
A truck pulls up. The manager opens POS. They tap through inventory — batch by batch, good or damaged — and hit confirm. Warehouse updates automatically. No calls. No waiting.
📦  Raise stock requests — auto-converts to a transfer order
✅  GRN with good/bad capture — warehouse updates instantly
🔄  Mark damaged stock — moves to correct bin automatically
Magic Moment 02
A farmer walks in.
Billed and out in
under 3 minutes.
Manager searches by mobile. Profile appears instantly. Live catalog, active offers, real stock. Right batch auto-selected. Invoice generated. Payment collected — cash or QR on screen. Ledger reconciles itself.
🔍  Search farmer by mobile — or register on the spot
🛒  Live catalog — prices, offers, stock from the farmer app
🧾  Invoice auto-pushed to finance — zero manual entry
💳  Cash (VAN) or dynamic UPI QR — both auto-reconcile
↩️  Returns same screen — condition captured, credit posted
Magic Moment 03
An online order
just came in.
The store handles it.
A farmer in the catchment ordered on the app. Routes directly to the nearest COCO store. Manager sees it in POS, marks available and triggers invoice in one tap. Returns handled on the same screen.
📲  DVS orders appear in POS — accept, flag OOS, or process
🚚  Invoice sent to WMS and logistics at dispatch
🔁  OOS triggers auto-restock — same engine as Saathi network
Every Rupee Tracked — Hisaab
Outstanding & VAN
Transaction History
Every sale.
Every payment.
Every settlement.
Cash deposits, UPI collections, DVS settlements — all tracked in one ledger, reconciled automatically. Zero outstanding means the store is clean.
Under the Hood
POS is not a billing app. It is the connective layer between three systems that had never spoken to each other in a retail context. When a sale happens on POS, all three know about it instantly and automatically.

Coming Next
Each COCO store will soon run its own promotions — independent pricing and store-level offers, so a store manager in Narayangaon can serve exactly what that village needs, without waiting for a central catalog update. The store manager becomes the merchandiser.
